desc: Implement trie insertion for all words, storing `cnt` per node; also record for each word its list of node ids along its path. Handle n-1 < k by returning all zeros early.
Compute per-depth qualifying info: for each depth, count of nodes with cnt >= k and a representative node id.

Optimize off-path query to O(1) per word: precompute deepest and second-deepest qualifying depths (with reps) and deepest depth with qual_count >= 2; off-path best = deepest qualifying depth unless its unique rep equals word's node at that depth, else max(second-deepest qualifying depth, deepest multi-qualifier depth).
Verify correctness on both examples plus edge cases (k=1, all identical words, n==k, single-character words, word that is a prefix of another) and confirm total complexity O(total characters).
Write the final solution in the starter code with clear comments.
